basic_details.offering_entity: Khalifa University of Science and Technology (Abu Dhabi, UAE)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: Khalifa University (Main Campus & Sas Al Nakhl Campus, Abu Dhabi, UAE)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Advanced STEM Disciplines: Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Robotics, Cybersecurity, Aerospace Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Civil & Infrastructure Engineering, Electrical Engineering & Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Nuclear Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, Materials Science & Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Chemistry, Physics.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~200 to 300 fully funded graduate scholarships awarded annually
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open global competition; Pakistan represents one of the largest international researcher groups at Khalifa University (typically 20 to 45 Pakistani awardees/yr)
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Full normative duration of degree: 2 years (MS) or 3 to 4 years (PhD)

nationality_requirements: Open to international applicants of all nationalities and UAE nationals
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Completed Bachelor's degree (16 years education) with minimum 3.25 / 4.00 CGPA for Master's; completed Master's degree (18 years education) with minimum 3.50 / 4.00 CGPA for PhD.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum 3.25 / 4.00 CGPA for Master's; minimum 3.50 / 4.00 CGPA for PhD; competitive applicants generally present 3.60+ CGPA.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Undergraduate/Master's major in engineering, computer science, mathematics, or natural sciences.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated or currently in final semester of degree graduating before semester start.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Research publications, thesis output, and technical project leadership heavily evaluated.

english_proficiency.notes: TOEFL iBT min 91 or IELTS Academic min 6.5. GRE General test is mandatory for all applicants (minimum Quantitative score of 150 required; 155+ recommended).

eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: English (100% of instruction and research conducted in English).
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Elite international engineering and science researchers.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Must not be holding another full scholarship concurrently.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full tuition fee waiver provided for all semesters.

admission_application_fee.details: Application through Khalifa University online admissions portal is 100% free of charge.

accommodation.details: Free furnished university student housing provided directly by Khalifa University in Abu Dhabi (or housing allowance).

monthly_stipend.details: Tier 1 Full Scholarship provides monthly living stipend: Master's students receive AED 4,000/month (~PKR 303,000/month / ~USD $1,090/month); PhD students receive AED 8,000/month (~PKR 606,000/month / ~USD $2,180/month).
monthly_stipend.amount: AED 4,000 (MS) to AED 8,000 (PhD) / month (~PKR 303,000 to 606,000 / month)

airfare.details: Annual round-trip economy flight ticket provided between Abu Dhabi and Pakistan.

visa_fee.details: UAE student residency visa processing, Emirates ID, and medical fitness tests covered by university.

health_insurance.details: Comprehensive UAE medical insurance coverage provided directly by Khalifa University.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Free course textbooks, research laboratories, cleanrooms, and high-performance computing provided.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Full travel and registration funding provided for presenting papers at international conferences.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Free university shuttle bus between student housing campuses and academic buildings.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single institution: Khalifa University of Science and Technology (Abu Dhabi, UAE).
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: #202 QS World University Rankings 2025; #1 in the United Arab Emirates; Top 25 globally for International Outlook.
available_majors: Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Robotics, Cybersecurity, Aerospace Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Nuclear Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, Materials Science, Physics, Chemistry, Applied Mathematics
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Bachelor's or Master's degree in engineering/science with minimum 3.25/3.50 CGPA, GRE score (Quant 150+), and English test score.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: AI, Robotics, and Aerospace Engineering are highly competitive; nuclear, petroleum, and civil engineering have slightly higher acceptance ratios.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Check the box for the 'Full Scholarship' on the central application portal and submit GRE scores with Quant above 158.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: Khalifa University Online Graduate Admissions Portal
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register on the Khalifa University online admissions portal during the Fall or Spring admissions window.
step_by_step_workflow: 1. Check application dates on Khalifa University website (typically opens October, closes late April for Fall intake).
2. Create account on Khalifa University online admissions system.
3. Select degree program and research department.
4. Tick the checkbox to apply for the Khalifa University Full Scholarship.
5. Upload Statement of Purpose, research proposal, CV, transcripts, GRE score report, and TOEFL/IELTS scores.
6. Register 2 academic referees who upload letters of recommendation.
7. Submit online application (100% free of charge).
8. Departmental committee conducts document evaluation and video interview (February-May).
9. Receive admission and scholarship offer in May/June.
10. University issues UAE student entry visa permit.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated automatic assessment through Khalifa University central admissions system.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Submitted online by 2 referees via Khalifa University automated referee portal.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Statement of Purpose describing academic trajectory, research accomplishments, why Khalifa University was chosen, and prospective faculty alignment.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Structured research proposal (1-2 pages) describing research questions, background literature, and proposed methodology.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Academic CV detailing publications, presentations, GPA, and software/engineering competencies.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Departmental faculty conduct 30-45 minute technical video interviews on domain depth and research methodology.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: GRE General test is mandatory for all applicants (minimum Quantitative score of 150 required).
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Degree certificates and transcripts must be attested by HEC Pakistan, MOFA, and UAE Embassy in Islamabad, followed by UAE Ministry of Education (MOE) equivalency certificate.

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Main intake is Fall (opens October, closes late April). Spring intake has an earlier deadline (closes late October).

selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Department Graduate Admissions Committee and Associate Provost for Graduate Studies.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Document screening (GPA + GRE + Publications) -> Technical faculty video interview -> University Scholarship Board final award allocation.

competitiveness_profile.total_scholarships_awarded: ~200 to 300 fully funded graduate scholarships annually
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Graduates from NUST, FAST, GIKI, UET Lahore, and COMSATS with solid GRE Quantitative scores (158+), first-author publications, and strong mathematical skills.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Strong Pakistani alumni presence in Robotics, AI, Chemical Engineering, and Petroleum Engineering at Khalifa University.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Pakistan, India, Egypt, Jordan, China, Nigeria, Lebanon, United States.

red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Application to Khalifa University is 100% free of charge. No application fee is charged.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Khalifa University has no commercial agents and does not work with third-party education consultants.
itemized_hidden_out_of_pocket_costs: UAE Embassy document attestation fees and UAE MOE certificate equivalency fees (~PKR 45,000 to 65,000)
GRE and IELTS/TOEFL exam registration fees
Initial pocket money before first monthly stipend payment (~AED 1,000)
debunked_myths_and_misconceptions: MYTH: You need Arabic language proficiency. (Truth: 100% of graduate lectures, examinations, and laboratory research are conducted in English).
MYTH: Flights are not included. (Truth: Khalifa University provides annual round-trip flight tickets to all international full scholarship recipients).
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Unofficial portals claim GRE is optional; Khalifa University strictly requires official GRE General scores for full scholarship consideration.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain a minimum cumulative GPA of 3.00 out of 4.00 for Master's and 3.30 out of 4.00 for PhD.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time physical research residence at Khalifa University campus.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Must assist in up to 10 hours per week of Teaching Assistantship (TA) or Research Assistantship (RA) duties; must publish required peer-reviewed journal papers (Scopus/Web of Science Q1/Q2) before PhD graduation.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Outside employment is strictly prohibited under UAE student visa regulations.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None; graduates have access to UAE's high-tech employment market and 10-year UAE Golden Visa for PhD holders.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: Assistantship service duties required during academic semester.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Scholarship is cancelled if GPA drops below threshold for two consecutive semesters or if student drops out.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Changing major requires approval from both department chairs and Associate Provost.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Maximum duration is 2 years for Master's and 4 years for PhD; extensions rarely granted.
